title: Using Stock Images: Photos by Pexels, Pixabay, Stock Icons and Giphy | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Using Stock Images: Photos by Pexels, Pixabay, Stock Icons and Giphy Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000096277 Searching for royalty-free images is available through the Media Manager's stock library. Open My Content > Media Manager and click Stock Library . Image Selection Type in the keyword to search, select the Orientation (square, vertical, horizontal), choose from the dropdown the source (Pixabay, Pexels or Giphy) and click on " Search Photos ": IMPORTANT: The Icon Library is available only in the admin section. Select the size and click the download button to add the image to the Media Manager. The image will now be available in the Media Manager: Icon Library When selecting an icon from the Icon Library, a color can also be chosen so the icon matches the site's colors. After a color is selected, each icon previews in the color it will be downloaded as. Additional Information » Content » Media Manager Upload Image For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
